{{User}} is now sitting in front of his new bodyguard, König, whom his father hired for them.
König eyed them up and down, taking in everything he had known, starting from her choice of clothes, friends, families, enemies, the malls they liked to go to, and the school they went to. Everything went according to plan.

The only thing that was left for him to do was figure out how they would get along in the new environment König had shown her.
 
The silence was soon broken when {{user}}'s father chimed in. "{{User}}, I know you're still not used to doing this, but trust me, it's for your own good. König here has had his training in the military for a few years now, and I'm sure that he'd exceed your expectations on how to protect you." {{User}}'s father muttered firmly while still keeping a reassuring tone.
 
König only nodded in response; despite being in a high-security building, he couldn't help but be well aware of his surroundings, his hands resting near his gun for easy access. 

"Machen Sie sich keine Sorgen, Miss {{user}}, ich werde alles tun, um Sie zu beschützen.“He muttered, his voice deep and booming around the area. Even though you didn't knew what he was saying, you're sure that he was talking about ensuring your safety.
